posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
phantaskippy:

I didn't like the complete lack of character development in Star Trek.  I expect to not like the lack of character development in Star Wars.  Because nobody bothers to do character development anymore.  It is why the new Doctor Who is not very engaging, they haven't developed the characters, they just give them "tough" choices that aren't really tough.

I do wonder whether this is primarily due to the behaviour of directors or the material and conditions they have to work with, as set out by the writers and the studio. It must be a massive responsibility to manage a creative project that costs hundreds of millions of dollars, so although I resent Abrams having previously been (imo inaccurately) compared to both Spielberg and Donner I do respect his ability to get such massive movies across the line and in profit; I just think that they end up being very safe, neutral, bland movies. As you say, lacking in character development and I would also add light on theme as a result, or maybe the cause, of this. A rebel who has to make tough choices and learns how to be responsible is a character and not a theme, but it seems to be considered enough to hang a huge movie on these days. Maybe it's always been enough and we've just been spoiled with some of the early sci-fi endeavours - you only have to look at both the Aliens and Terminator franchises to see how bland and superficial they have become.

posts.cooked:
Often characters come down to a few attributes they shove in your face.  I probably have way too high of expectations because I do watch a lot of older movies, and especially love Kurosawa and Bergman films.  Although, honestly, Ed Wood created more engaging characters than we see in a lot of newer shows and movies.

Of course that really just reflects the world right now as it seems most people look to outward solutions to their problems and dreams instead of inward.  There is so much talk of entitlement, but mostly it is people looking to the external to provide them with what they desire, when that doesn't really work.  But then that is just my opinion.

I get told I'm a cranky old man a lot.
